evidence.title: Richmond County Celebrates Historic $10 Billion Investment from Amazon Web Services
evidence.excerpt: Richmond County identifies the planned AWS campus in Energy Way Industrial Park and says it will support AI infrastructure and cloud computing technologies.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of retrieved HTML response bytes
metadata.coordinate_basis: Approximate analyst placement within Energy Way Industrial Park; not a parcel boundary or individual-building coordinate.
metadata.site_scope: The county places the campus on nearly 800 acres in Energy Way Industrial Park in the Hamlet-Rockingham area.
metadata.status_guardrail: This announcement establishes site and program scope but not physical construction. The separate Amazon-authored 2025-10-30 groundbreaking is the construction-start evidence.
metadata.future_building_guardrail: The county's 20 data-center buildings and 200,000-to-225,000-square-foot ranges describe the announced full campus plan, not buildings proven started, completed, or operational.
metadata.workload_scope: The county explicitly describes both Amazon AI infrastructure and cloud computing technologies; the project workload is therefore recorded only as mixed, without a training, inference, customer, or chip subtype.
metadata.investment_guardrail: The $10 billion figure is investment and is not imported as capacity or energy.
